extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and professional comic book writers looking for script templates, example scripts, and critique/mentoring services
extracted.subtask_description: Providing and using a standard script format for comic-book scripts, plus learning from published example scripts and paid critique/mentoring offerings. The page hosts an archive of sample scripts and links to a suggested Comics Experience script template.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comics Experience Script Template (suggested script format)
rubrics_metrics.description: Suggested script format template from Comics Experience (Word).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides a downloadable Word template labeled 'The Comics Experience Script Template' as the recommended formatting standard for comic-book scripts. Use the template when preparing scripts for submission or critique; reference the archive of professional scripts on the page to see examples of formatting and industry practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn from published script examples
rubrics_metrics.description: An archive of professional comic-book scripts (multiple authors and titles) is provided as an educational resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Browse and study the listed scripts (available in Word, PDF, RTF, TXT, DOC) to understand real-world script structure, scene descriptions, panel breakdowns, and authorial conventions. The presence of many professional scripts implies using samples as models for pacing, panel descriptions, and dialogue formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek professional critique or mentoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Paid services are offered for script critique, mentoring, and courses (e.g., Introduction to Comic Book Writing Bundle, Pro Script Critique).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If seeking evaluative feedback, consider the site's paid 'Pro Script Critique' and mentoring options (prices shown, $50–$300 range) as formal ways to get standards-based review. Contact info (info@comicsexperience.com) is provided for questions or script donations.
